title: [Issue]: Failure to refresh libraries after update. Readonly database.
body:
### Please describe your bug

Since upgrading to 10.9.5 I see the following exception being thrown in the Jellyfin logs when I refresh a library that has had new videos added.

I'm not familiar with the Jellyfin codebase at all and may be jumping ahead but assume this could be related to the readonly database changes made in the PR: https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/pull/11969

### Reproduction Steps

With 10.9.5 server installed:

1. Add additional files (e.g. videos)
2. Request a library refresh
3. Video/music etc is not added to library and a 'readonly database' exception is thrown.

### Jellyfin Version

10.9.0

_No response_

The error that caused this is apparently fixed in 10.9.5, but since this release is now also buggy I would recommend to stay at 10.9.3 until this issue here is fixed as well.

comments.author: participant10
comments.body:
I had this issue after 10.9.5 restart. 

Can confirm, for me, setting parallel scan to 1 resolved the issue for me, so far, in 10.9.5.  I had bumped it back to 2 in 10.9.4 but had to take it back to 1. Set `Dashboard -> General -> Performance -> Set "Parallel library scan tasks limit" and "Parallel image encoding limit" both to 1`.https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/issues/11957#issuecomment-2149346186

New items have scanned and been added. 
My system: Windows 10, Jellyfin 10.9.5
